errors.quote: la división interna de la FORA tras el noveno congreso (1909)
errors.reason: The video gives no year for the ninth congress (captions omit it at 12:28); 1909 is only the founding year of the CORA (12:07) and of the Semana Roja.
The video says the setback produced a progressive displacement of anarchists in labor leadership, to be analyzed in the next episode (24:11-24:21), not an end of their influence.
